map.药品经营GSP质量管理合规检查，从八个维度评分对照《药品经营质量管理规范》判定合: Score eight management system check items together with the recorded temperature and humidity, then read the total out of 80 as a percentage readiness grade.
map.总分 = 八项检查得分之和（每项 0–10，满分 80）: Total score = sum of the eight check scores (each 0-10, out of 80)
map.达标率(%) = 总分 ÷ 80 × 100，并结合记录的温度与湿度给出综合评级: Compliance rate (%) = total score ÷ 80 × 100, combined with the recorded temperature and humidity for an overall grade
map.1. 质量管理体系与文件（1-10分）: 1. Quality management system and documents (1-10 points)
map.药品经营GSP质量管理合规检查工具，从质量体系、人员培训、设施设备、采购验收、储: A GSP pharmaceutical quality management compliance check tool that scores eight dimensions: quality system, personnel training, facilities and equipment, purchasing and acceptance, storage and maintenance, sales and after-sales, transport and distribution, and information management.
map.药品零售企业GSP自查: GSP self-check for pharmaceutical retail enterprises
map.药品批发企业质量审计: Quality audit for pharmaceutical wholesale enterprises
map.药监部门GSP检查: GSP inspection by drug regulatory authorities
map.📚 深度解析：管理体系合规自查: 📚 Deep Dive: Management System Compliance Self-Check
map.内审准备：按八项条款逐条打分，先自行定位薄弱环节: Internal audit prep: score each of the eight clauses to identify weak points in advance
map.迎检自查：把现场温湿度记录一并录入，输出整改优先级: Pre-inspection self-check: enter the on-site temperature and humidity records together to output a rectification priority
map.月度复核：固定口径重复评分，观察达标率趋势: Monthly review: repeat the scoring with a fixed rubric and watch the compliance-rate trend
map.算法：八项检查各按 0–10 分录入，满分 80；达标率 = 总分 ÷ 80 ×: Algorithm: enter each of the eight checks as 0-10 points, out of 80; compliance rate = total ÷ 80 × 100; then combine with the recorded temperature and humidity for an overall grade. Each value must be 0-10.
map.例1（八项均 10 分）：总分 80，达标率 100.0%，说明各条款均已落实。: Example 1 (all eight at 10 points): total 80, compliance rate 100.0%, meaning every clause is in place. Example 2 (all eight at 5 points): total 40, compliance rate 50.0%; the lowest-scoring clauses should be rectified first.
map.打分标准怎么定？: How should the scoring criteria be set?
map.建议按证据充分性给分：有制度且有执行记录给 8–10 分，仅有制度给 4–7 分: Score by the sufficiency of evidence: 8-10 points when there is both a system and execution records, 4-7 with the system only, and 0-3 when both are missing; avoid giving every item the same score, which would remove any discrimination.
map.温湿度为什么也计入？: Why are temperature and humidity included too?
map.仓储与生产环境对温湿度有明确要求，属于现场检查的固定项；把它与条款分并列，可提醒: Storage and production environments have explicit temperature and humidity requirements, which are a fixed item in on-site inspections; listing it alongside the clause scores reminds you that an out-of-range environment is equally a non-conformity.
map.GSP（《药品经营质量管理规范》）是药品流通环节法定标准: GSP (Good Supply Practice for Pharmaceutical Products) is the statutory standard for pharmaceutical distribution
map.温湿度记录必须每日至少2次，数据保存≥5年: Temperature and humidity must be recorded at least twice a day, with data retained for at least 5 years
map.处方药与非处方药须分区陈列，特殊管理药品双人双锁: Prescription and non-prescription drugs must be displayed in separate zones, and specially controlled drugs kept under double lock with two people
map.药品近效期预警（6个月）并实施催销或退换货: Near-expiry warning for drugs (6 months) with promotion or return/exchange
map.GSP认证证书有效期5年，到期前6个月申请重新认证: The GSP certificate is valid for 5 years; apply for recertification 6 months before expiry
